title: Stream Backpressure & Full-Jitter Reconnect
description: Trace how consumer backpressure throttles socket reads and how full-jitter backoff spreads reconnects.

steps.label: 1. Consumer Stalls (desiredSize <= 0)
steps.description: UI renderer pauses reader.read() during a heavy frame, filling the ReadableStream highWaterMark.

steps.label: 2. Drop & Full-Jitter Window
steps.description: Socket closes with 1006; client samples a uniform random delay in [0, min(30s, 500ms * 2^attempt)].

steps.label: 3. Decorrelated Resume
steps.description: Client reconnects with Last-Event-ID or cursor, or aborts cleanly if AbortSignal fires during the sleep.
